title: Optimization session summary
description: Final per-session machine-readable summary written by finalize-session.sh. Bumped to schema_version 2 to add per-experiment delivery_mode and the consensus-routing statuses introduced in Phase 9.

outcome_counts.description: Demo-friendly aggregate: how many targets fell into each (delivery_mode, status) combination. Used by summary.md to produce the headline outcome tally without re-grouping experiments[]. The structure matches the valid combinations enforced by the experiment-level allOf below.

lens_dispositions.description: Carried verbatim from optimization-targets.json. The summary phase propagates this so 'real hotspot, no fix found' cases (lens_disposition.status == not_actionable) are visible in summary.md without operators needing to crack open the merge artifacts.

allOf.description: Mirror of the optimization-targets.json constraint: when status == not_actionable, the operator-facing explanation MUST be preserved. The whole value of propagating lens_dispositions into summary is keeping this reason visible.

delivery_mode.description: Carried from optimization-targets.json. Determines which `status` values are valid for this experiment row — see allOf below.

status.description: Outcome of this target. accepted/rejected = bench measured a real improvement (or didn't), normal_pr only. poc_landed = consensus_poc_pr's scoped tests passed and an implementation.md exists (no benchmark runs by design). routed_to_issue = consensus_issue's analyzer skipped the optimizer and the consensus-issue.md routing marker is present. aborted = pipeline did not produce a usable artifact: optimizer wrote abort.md or produced no output (normal_pr / consensus_poc_pr); routing marker missing (consensus_issue).

breakage_class.description: Surfaced for consensus_poc_pr / consensus_issue rows so summary.md can show the consensus-rule kind without joining back to optimization-targets.json. Carried verbatim from the merged target.

allOf.description: Status value must be valid for this delivery_mode. Seven legal combinations: (normal_pr, accepted|rejected|aborted), (consensus_poc_pr, poc_landed|aborted), (consensus_issue, routed_to_issue|aborted). Each `aborted` row represents a pipeline failure to produce a usable artifact for that delivery_mode (optimizer abort/no-output, or — for consensus_issue — missing routing marker).
